feeds.title: Austin Woman Magazine
feeds.description: Austin Woman magazine is the leading magazine for women in Austin and the ONLY women-centric publication of its kind. The magazine covers a range of topics, including health and wellness, fashion and beauty, arts and entertainment, food and drink, home and design, and business and career.

feeds.title: Women Communicators of Austin Blog
feeds.description: Women Communicators of Austin Blog covers topics such as self-growth articles, spring stories, feature stories, and more interesting articles. Dating back to 1929, Women Communicators of Austin (WCA) is one of the largest and most diverse professional communications organizations in Austin.

feeds.title: Impact Austin Blog
feeds.description: Impact Austin is a women's collective giving group that has given $8.07 MILLION to Central Texas nonprofits! They cultivate the collective wisdom & strength of women to transform ourselves and our communities through philanthropy. Their vision is to unlock the potential in our community by uniting to fulfill our philanthropic purpose. Impact Austin blog shares information on the latest news, updates from the community, events, members spotlight and more.

feeds.title: The Work at Home Woman Blog
feeds.description: I'm Holly Reisem Hanna, the founder of The Work at Home Woman. If you're searching for a work-at-home job, or if you want to launch your own home-based business - you're in the right place. Named by Forbes (twice) as one of the top websites for your career, The Work at Home Woman helps individuals find remote careers and businesses that feed their souls with job leads, ideas, and reputable information.

feeds.title: Austin Business Woman Blog
feeds.description: Austin Business Woman Blog is a platform founded by Katie Kime, a designer, and entrepreneur, with a mission to empower and inspire women in business. The blog features articles on business strategies, entrepreneurship, and self-care for women. They help people find all women-owned businesses of Austin in one place.

feeds.title: The U.T. Faculty Women's Organization
feeds.description: The U.T. Faculty Women's Organization The Faculty Women's Organization is a community of women scholars that gives a space to interact and network with other women faculty and professional staff on campus through panels, talks and social events. The purpose of the organization is to provide support for women and families in the campus community.

feeds.title: iSaveA2Z.com
feeds.description: We are dedicated to sharing our favorite recipes, crafting our best crafts and helping you saving a little bit of money along this crazy ride called life!

feeds.title: Camille Styles
feeds.description: A daily lifestyle publication that covers design, fashion, entertaining, food, style, travel & wellness. Camille Styles is your go-to guide to living your best life.

feeds.title: Renee Rouleau Skin Care Blog
feeds.description: Renee Rouleau believes in educating others about the different skin types and how best to treat them. With over 1,000 posts, this blog is a go-to resource for all skincare needs by beauty enthusiasts. Renée Rouleau is a trusted and sought-after skin care expert and esthetician loved by celebrities, editors, influencers and skincare obsessives everywhere.

feeds.title: Austin Women's Health Center Blog
feeds.description: Follow their Austin Women's Health Center Blog to see the latest posts on women's health. A great source of education, and news from the clinic. At Austin Women's Health Center we are dedicated to offering our patients comprehensive gynecological health care and reproductive healthcare services in a private and supportive environment. Austin Women's Health Center was founded in 1976 with the belief that everyone deserves access to high-quality reproductive health care in a private and personal setting.

feeds.title: Erin Ruoff
feeds.description: Hi, Lovely is a place to share outfits, babies, treats, and travels. Focused on photography, fashion and greater well-being of this new mama's life.

feeds.title: Dressed to Kill
feeds.description: Dressed to Kill owner, Ashley Hargrove, is a commercial advertising wardrobe stylist, model and fashion blogger sharing her personal style and tips as well as behind the scenes of her many advertising projects.

feeds.title: Alicia in Wonderland
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Alicia, and dressing up brings me joy. This little corner of the internet is here to inspire you to love how you live and dress. I created this blog to share the wonder and loveliness of everyday life from my perspective. Please stay a while as a share style tips, career struggles, and travel diaries! I hope this blog inspires you and brings you as much happiness as it brings me to create it.

feeds.title: Nicole Sometimes
feeds.description: Nicole Sometimes by Nicole Fuentes is a Fashion and Lifestyle blog based in Austin, Texas.

feeds.title: Natalie Paramore
feeds.description: I write about restaurants and make recipes because I'm pretty much always that person who while still eating lunch is already asking what's for dinner!

feeds.title: Kimberly Cobb
feeds.description: My name is Kimberly Cobb and I'm a Lifestyle Blogger. Originally from California now living in Austin, Texas! I am also a San Diego State alumna, Pomeranian mom, + travel lover! I use this blog to share my favorite places, people, and products with thousands of people all over the world. Thanks for stopping by!

feeds.title: XOCHI SOLIS
feeds.description: The author, Xochi Solis, is an artist and educator, and many of the posts on the blog relate to her artwork, exhibitions, and creative process. stopics covered on the blog include travel, food, personal reflections, and social justice issues.

feeds.title: YWCA Austin Blog
feeds.description: YWCA Greater Austin is on a mission to eliminate racism, empower women, stand up for social justice, help families, and strengthen communities. We are one of the oldest women's organizations in the Greater Austin area, serving over 4500 women, girls, and their families annually. The Austin blog shares articles on women, women's rights, empowerment, indigenous people, the need to vote, and more similar public interest articles.
